description: Use this when the user asks about a kanji (a Chinese character used in Japanese): which JLPT words use it and how it is read in them, at which JLPT level it first appears, or where to learn it. For each kanji given (up to five), lists the words in the site’s JLPT word list that contain it, easiest level first, with reading, level and meaning in the user’s language; how many words use it and the lowest level among them; and the site’s kanji lessons that teach it (title, link, and whether each is free or needs a subscription or pass). Gives no on’yomi/kun’yomi table or stroke order: the readings are those of the words.

kanji.description: One to five kanji, e.g. "生" or "日本".

lang.description: The user’s language for meanings, labels and links: zh-Hans (Simplified Chinese), zh-Hant (Traditional Chinese), en (English) or ko (Korean). Other languages: en. Default: guessed from the query.

limit.description: How many words to list per kanji at most.

name: lookup_kanji

free.description: false: needs a subscription or pass

title: Words that use a kanji
